 FT: Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Unai Emery will be absolutely thrilled.
 Four years in the job, four home wins in a row over Manchester City and a first home win of the season.
 Image source, Getty Images

 'Villa were absolutely superb' published at 14:25 BST 14:25 BST 
 FT: Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Lucy Ward 
Former Leeds striker on TNT Sports 
 Wonderful to watch. Villa just stepped it up when they needed to, man for man they were brilliant. 
 City just didn't have enough and Villa were absolutely superb.

 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Aston Villa beat Manchester City at home for the fourth season in a row. Manchester City suffer a first defeat of the season and a first defeat in the league under Enzo Maresca.
 Image source, Getty Images

 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Emi Buendia goes into the book for a bit of petulence.
 It's all kicking off on the touchline as well between Enzo Maresca and some of the Aston Villa coaching staff.

 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City

Former Leeds striker on TNT Sports 
 I think the most impressive thing about Aston Villa has been they've wrestled it back with such an important reaction from Unai Emery's side.

 Post published at 90+3 mins 90+3 mins 
 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Aston Villa win a free-kick and are moments away from claiming bragging rights for inflicting a first defeat of the season on league-leaders Manchester City.
 Somthing much of the league will want more than ever this season.

 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Owen Hargreaves 
Former Manchester United midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Matty Cash has been flawless, all the Villa players have been. 
 Every Aston Villa player has won numerous one on one battles this afternoon. 
 Image source, Getty Images

 Post published at 90+2 mins 90+2 mins 
 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Woops. Ibrahim Mbaye gets the throw-in all wrong and it ends up behind him.
 Villa lose the ball and it ends up with Jeremy Doku down the left but Mbaye makes up for it with a vital challenge.

 'Maatsen did really well' published at 14:18 BST 14:18 BST 
 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Lucy Ward 
Former Leeds striker on TNT Sports 
 Ian Maatsen did really well. 
 He adjusts his position and he makes sure it doesn't end up in the net or back near Erling Haaland.

 INJURY TIME published at 90 mins 90 mins 
 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Four minutes for City to salvage a point and for Villa to pick up their first home win in the Premier League this season.

 Post published at 89 mins 89 mins 
 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 A really good ball from Phil Foden dug out from close to the by line but Erling Haaland's header is blocked by Ian Maatsen.
 It's starting to feel like it's just not City's day.

 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 There have been three instances of a player attempting 17+ dribbles in a Premier League match since 2025, with Jeremy Doku being responsible for all three - 21 v Liverpool in Feb 2025, 19 v Brighton in March 2025 and 17 against Aston Villa today.

 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City

 SUBSTITUTION published at 82 mins 82 mins 
 Aston Villa 2-1 Man City 
 Changes for the hosts.
 Brian Madjo and Leon Goretzka are on for Joao Gomes and Nicolas Jackson. No hat-trick for him today.
 Madjo is only 17-years-old, this will be his first Premier League appearance.
